name: @ttypt/joint
description: Universal Node.js and Browser bindings for libjoint Interval-Tree Temporal Engine

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node -I../include -I../../libcorm/include -I../../libqsys/include native/joint_napi.c -L../lib -Wl,-rpath,../lib -L/usr/lib -ljoint -lcorm -o build/Release/joint_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: Paulo Quirino
